name: Natural gas boiler
source: price: Destatis PD26_345 (non-household gas H1 2026, 1000-10000 GJ per year, 8.11 ct/kWh incl. national CO2 levy of 55 EUR/t) minus 11.06 EUR/MWh CO2 levy because the model adds the CO2 cost separately; other columns synthetic_assumption
note: Price per MWh Hs for a commercial customer. CO2 price is added by the model (economics.co2_price_eur_per_t)

name: Fuel oil boiler
source: price: 2026 heating oil portal prices (Tecson, HeizOel24, Esyoil; about 135 EUR/100 l gross average of March to October 2026, 10 kWh/l, without VAT, minus 14.6 EUR/MWh CO2 levy); other columns synthetic_assumption
note: Light fuel oil. The 2026 price is volatile (96 EUR/100 l in August 2025, 172 EUR/100 l in October 2026)

name: LPG boiler
note: Liquefied petroleum gas, sites without gas grid

name: District heating
note: Mixed network, price per MWh of heat bought, efficiency covers the transfer station and secondary losses

name: Wood pellet boiler
note: Biogenic CO2 counted as zero, upstream emissions only

name: Wood chip boiler
note: Cheap fuel, needs storage and operation effort

name: Biomethane boiler
note: Green gas bought via gas grid

name: Gas CHP (heat side)
note: Thermal efficiency only. Electricity revenue of the CHP is NOT credited, so the heat cost is overstated

name: Solar thermal collectors
note: Not dispatchable, covers a fixed share of the heat, free fuel

name: Grid electricity to power to heat
source: Destatis PD26_345 (non-household electricity price H1 2026, 20-500 MWh per year, 23.66 ct/kWh, provisional, without VAT); UBA Climate Change 16/2026 (German electricity mix 2025, 344 g CO2/kWh)
note: Price includes network charges, levies and electricity tax. The planned industrial electricity price relief is not included. Efficiency column is the resistive fallback: the energy model uses its hourly heat pump COP

name: Curtailed electricity (par. 13k EnWG) to power to heat
source: German TSOs, par. 13k EnWG implementation, minimum bid price Oct to Dec 2026 (23.83 EUR/MWh, cap 313 EUR/MWh); grid fees, levies and electricity tax are compensated by the grid operators
note: Minimum price of the monthly bid. The realised price depends on the bid of the facility and lies between the minimum and the cap. Availability from data/inputs/curtailment_signal.csv

name: Air to water heat pump plant
note: Capital cost of the power to heat plant when heater_type is heat_pump. Efficiency is the hourly COP of the energy model. Grid connection upgrade not included

name: Electric boiler plant
source: Danish Energy Agency technology data (electric boiler), as used in Cell Reports Sustainability 2025, techno-economic analysis of low and medium temperature industrial heat: 0.10 MEUR2023/MW, fixed O&M 1144 EUR2023/MW/a, variable O&M 0.99 EUR/MWh, lifetime 20 years
note: Capital cost of the power to heat plant when heater_type is resistive. Values are for the equipment, grid connection not included. Small commercial units can cost more

name: Flexibility controller and grid signal interface
note: Metering, control logic and signal interface per facility. Needed by strategies that use curtailed power
